Name: Pokemon Eggventure - Pets
Author: Parme69
Description:
[size=5][b]Pokemon Eggventure - Pets[/b][/size]

[b]Adopt a Pokémon starter instead of a cat or a dog.[/b] It grows with your friendship, evolves, and brings you gifts that match what type it is.

[size=4][b]Two ways to play[/b][/size]

[b]This mod stands on its own.[/b] Installed alone, it adds everything it needs: the Pokémon, their cries, their evolutions, the stones that trigger them, and gifts drawn from vanilla items.

[b]Installed alongside the new update of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/49098]Pokemon Eggventure[/url] in October[/b], it steps aside for it:

[list]
[*]The evolution stones [b]disappear from the shops[/b] — you'll find them in the mines, like every other item in the main pack.[/*]
[*]Your pet's gifts [b]change[/b]: no more coal and clams, but the energies, petals, herbs and seeds of the pack.[/*]
[/list]
Nothing to configure: the mod detects Pokemon Eggventure on its own and switches.

[line]

[size=4][b]What the mod adds[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]29 Pokémon to choose from[/b] at character creation: the nine starters of each generation, in Grass, Fire and Water, plus Pichu and Eevee.[/*]
[*][b]101 forms in total[/b], evolutions and mega evolutions included.[/*]
[*][b]A cry of its own for every Pokémon[/b], taken from the games.[/*]
[*][b]Marnie brings it to you on day two[/b]: she found it outside her barn, and nobody in town knows its trainer.[/*]
[*][b]Gifts by type[/b]: your Pokémon brings you the energy of its element, and now and then something rarer.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=4][b]The Pokémon and their evolutions[/b][/size]

[b]Budget[/b]: 1,200 to 2,500 g for a stone, 8,000 g for a mega stone. Taking an Eevee through all eight forms, across eight saves, comes to [b]11,700 g[/b] in total.

[size=3][b]The Everstone: keeping your Pokémon as it is[/b][/size]

Not everyone wants a Charizard. If you'd rather keep your Charmander — or your Pichu, or your Eevee — the Everstone is for that.

[list=1]
[*][b]Hold it[/b] and click on your Pokémon.[/*]
[*]A message confirms: [i]"Your Pokémon will no longer change form."[/i][/*]
[*]It [b]stops evolving[/b], whatever your friendship, and stones have no effect on it.[/*]
[*][b]A second click lifts the lock[/b]: [i]"Your Pokémon can evolve again."[/i] If friendship is already past the threshold, it will evolve the next morning.[/*]
[/list]
The stone is [b]not consumed[/b]: use it as often as you like, on as many Pokémon as you like.

[b]Where to find it[/b]: at Pierre's General Store for 2,500 g — or in the mines if you have the main pack.

[size=3][b]Mega evolutions[/b][/size]

They are [b]not permanent[/b]. Hold the mega stone again, click once more, and your Pokémon returns to its previous form — just like in the games.

[line]

[size=4][b]What your Pokémon brings you[/b][/size]

A happy Pokémon leaves a gift outside your door [b]roughly one day in five[/b]. What it brings depends on two things: [b]its type[/b], and [b]your friendship[/b].

[size=3][b]The five thresholds[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]100 points[/b] — gifts begin. At this stage it's always the energy of its type.[/*]
[*][b]250, 450, 650 and 850 points[/b] — each threshold adds a new item to the draw.[/*]
[/list]
Every gift uses the same draw: [b]nine chances in ten[/b] for the energy of its type, [b]one in ten[/b] for the rare item of the highest threshold you've reached.

A pet's friendship caps at a thousand points, so the last threshold is reachable — but it's earned: pet it every day, and count on a season or two.

[line]

[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].[/*]
[*]Unzip the archive into your [b]Mods[/b] folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game, start a save, and pick your starter.[/*]
[/list]
The archive holds [b]two folders[/b]: the content pack and a small C# mod that handles evolutions. Both are required.

[b]Safe to add[/b] to an existing save, but the starting pet is chosen at character creation: on an existing save, adopt one from Marnie instead.

[line]

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Pokemon Eggventure[/b] — optional, but recommended. The two complement each other.[/*]
[*][b]Any mod that adds pets[/b] — no conflict, the types simply add up.[/*]
[*][b]Mods that reskin the cat or dog[/b] — no effect here.[/*]
[/list]
[line]
